reviews.text: Great vets!

The team here is exceptional. We’ve visited a few times and their focus on quality really stands out. Rapha spent 45 minutes going through our cat’s history with us and mapping out the best plan of action. She was so caring, followed up after our appointments, and even brought back a can of food we couldn’t source so our cat could try it. Ed at reception is great too, clear, accommodating, and happy to help find an urgent appointment elsewhere when we needed one. It’s rare to find this level of care. Keep up the great work!

I have been bringing my cat, Cosimo, to Just Cats for a couple of years now and just wanted to praise Ester and the wider clinic team for their high standard of care. Cosimo is an extremely nervous and spicy cat and they are so understanding with him. He's been having some concerning issues lately which has been so stressful for me, and Ester has been a brilliant communicator and listener, never making me feel rushed or strange for asking questions. As someone who really takes my cat's health seriously, I'm so grateful to have Just Cats and Ester here in Dublin.
Lovely and very involved team that are truly specialized in cats.

Once again all the staff at Just Cats made the visit for Gus so smooth, calm and welcoming. Whether it’s a routine visit or an emergency they never fail to put Gus and myself at ease, fully explaining why everything and are so reassuring. They never disappoint, I would always recommend.

I had a very disturbing experience with this clinic and I feel it is important to warn other pet owners.

I brought my cat here because he was unwell and the clinic performed a blood test. I was told his red blood cell level was extremely low (12) and that he was very sick and unlikely to recover. The vet even suggested that I should consider euthanasia so he could “die in peace.”

I was devastated and crying because I believed I was about to lose my cat.

Thankfully I decided to take him to an emergency clinic for a second opinion. They repeated the blood test immediately and the result showed his red blood cell level was 29, which is close to normal.

Because of this, he did NOT need oxygen therapy or a blood transfusion. If I had followed the advice given by this clinic and agreed to euthanasia, my cat could have died unnecessarily.

I also pay for their monthly health plan, which is supposed to include certain services like blood tests. However, every time tests are needed I am told they are not covered and I receive additional expensive bills.

This experience caused me extreme emotional distress and nearly cost my pet his life. I strongly advise other pet owners to always seek a second opinion if they receive serious or life-changing diagnoses.

Formal Complaint – Expired Medication Issued

I am writing to formally raise a serious concern regarding my recent experience at your clinic.

In December, I brought my cat to your clinic due to ongoing and persistent vomiting. Your veterinarian prescribed Omeprazole and instructed me to administer the medication for four weeks. I was also informed that if her condition did not improve, she would require an endoscopy costing approximately €1,400.

I followed the treatment exactly as advised. During those four weeks, my cat continued vomiting every two days, and I was already preparing myself financially and emotionally for the recommended endoscopy.

However, when I later purchased Omeprazole from a pharmacy to compare the dosage, I discovered that the medication dispensed by your clinic had expired four months prior to being given to me. This means my cat was treated for four weeks with expired medication.

This is extremely concerning. Not only was the treatment potentially ineffective, but expired medication may also pose risks to an animal’s health. Had I not personally checked the expiry date, I would have proceeded with an expensive invasive procedure without knowing the real issue.

When I returned to the clinic to speak with the manager and requested a refund, I was informed that:
•	They were “doing a check today” to discard expired medications.
•	The only solution offered was replacement tablets.
•	A refund was refused.
•	No apology was given.

I also felt that my concerns were not taken seriously and that I was spoken to in an unprofessional and dismissive manner.

Dispensing expired medication is a serious breach of professional responsibility. As a pet owner, I trusted your clinic with my animal’s health. Instead, I am left feeling deeply disappointed, frustrated, and concerned about patient safety standards.
I do not recommend this veterinary clinic to anyone. Please avoid going there. In my experience, the staff were unprofessional and incompetent, and I was very disappointed with the level of care provided.

I'd like to update my review because I have to give praise to the staff of 2025, Esther, Sophie, Kim and Ed. They took care of my foster cat Sadie and her seven kittens. Esther took no chances with a two week old kitten we named Tucker. He had a serious infection brought on by sibling suckling. She came up with a plan to treat this tiny little kitten and she saved his life. Just cats were always on the end of the phone to help with any concerns I had for this precious family. There were times when we weren't charged or given discounts to help this little family. Kim done an amazing job microchipping all seven kittens, they didn't feel a thing. Most of all I want to give compliments to Esther. She is an amazing vet, so thorough and so knowledgeable and I have never seen a spay incision as small and as neat as Sadies. Thank you Esther! You and your team are amazing!!!!!
